page: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-480GB-2xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 24 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processors on the x86_64 architecture. The system features 480 GB of system memory, providing 20 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by two NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs with a combined VRAM of 160 GB. The virtualized environment runs on the KVM hypervisor with shared CPU allocation. Local storage is not included in this configuration.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance across compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a Passmark CPU score of 55,980.84 and a multi-core stress-ng score of 52,357.03. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 4,086.55 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 290.6 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression performs in the top tier at 15.63 GB/sec, while multi-threaded decompression reaches 355.23 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the system achieves 10,457.59 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 366.07 tokens/sec for text generation on a 135M parameter LLM.

This server represents a high-density resource profile optimized for parallel processing and large-scale memory-bound tasks. The qualitative cost efficiency is defined by the integration of dual enterprise-grade H100 GPUs alongside a substantial 480 GB memory footprint, though the shared CPU allocation and lack of local storage require external storage solutions and may introduce CPU scheduling variability. It is highly suited for deep learning, large language model inference, data science pipelines, and high-throughput database operations.
